About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced and versatile Japan Consumer Marketing Manager to develop and execute locally relevant consumer programs in one of our most important and culturally nuanced markets.

Reporting to the Japan Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on role for a full-stack consumer marketer with deep understanding of the Japanese consumer landscape—someone who can translate strategy into locally resonant campaigns, shape narratives that build trust, and accelerate adoption and repeat usage at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong consumer marketing instincts with excellent execution in complex, cross-functional environments.

This role will manage integrated initiatives spanning brand, product storytelling, digital, social, creators, partnerships, community, and lifecycle, while representing the voice of Japanese consumers internally.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute Japan-specific consumer marketing plans under the Japan Marketing Lead, ensuring strong local relevance while aligning with global priorities.

- Drive full-funnel initiatives that grow users and weekly active users, deepen activation and repeat usage, and improve retention, advocacy, and sentiment.

- Act as a local expert and thought partner—bringing deep insights into Japanese culture, consumer behavior, and media dynamics to inform strategy, creative, and execution.

- Manage and collaborate with local agencies, creators, and production partners to deliver culturally authentic, high-quality campaigns and content.

- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including product marketing, communications, partnerships, and regional leadership to deliver integrated programs with clear impact.

- Represent the voice of Japan internally, ensuring local nuance, context, and market realities are reflected in marketing strategy, messaging, and decision-making.

Qualifications:

- 7+ years of marketing experience, with a strong track record of delivering high-impact consumer campaigns and measurable user or usage growth in Japan.

- Deep understanding of the Japanese consumer landscape, cultural context, and local media and marketing ecosystems.

- Proven ability to build and execute integrated marketing plans across brand, digital, influencer/creator, and partner channels.

- Comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on executional levels in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

- Strong network of local agencies, creatives, creators, and production partners; demonstrated experience managing external partners.

- Excellent communicator and collaborator, with the ability to influence stakeholders across functions and geographies.

jobs.description: Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a AMZL Performance Manager to own the end-to-end network performance monitoring, analysis, and improvement function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role sits within the Ops Excellence team, part of the Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization, covering the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large) programs. As an Individual Contributor, you will be the single-threaded owner of AMZL performance in a overall visibility — building and maintaining dashboards, conducting root cause analyses, tracking corrective actions, and providing data-driven recommendations that move operational metrics in the right direction. You will work closely with Operations, regional leadership, and cross-functional partners to ensure performance gaps are identified early, diagnosed accurately, and resolved systematically. This role reports directly to the Ops Excellence Manager and works cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Planning, and partner-facing teams to ensure network performance decisions are data-driven, scalable, and aligned with Last Mile Brazil's growth objectives. This position is based out of an AMZL office and may require periodic travel to delivery stations across Brazil. If you are passionate about operational analytics, performance management, and driving measurable improvement across a complex logistics network, come join our team. Key job responsibilities Own the end-to-end AMZL network performance view across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, providing a consolidated AMZL perspective on operational performance, defects, and trends Drive AMZL overall performance monitoring and improvement across key performance metrics: DEA, Last Mile BPS, Concessions, TPH, DPPH, OTD, FPY, Scorecard, and SIR Build and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide real-time visibility into network performance, partner performance, and operational KPIs Conduct root cause analyses for performance deviations, identifying top offenders and structural defects across the partner network Develop and track corrective action plans in partnership with Operations and regional leadership, ensuring accountability and follow-through on short and mid-term improvements Establish and maintain KPI governance mechanisms — defining thresholds, escalation triggers, and performance review cadences (daily/weekly/monthly) Produce the weekly and monthly AMZL Network Performance Reports, including trend analysis, deep-dives on underperformers, and corrective action status across all partner programs Support partner performance guidance by translating Amazon's operational standards into actionable insights and recommendations for logistics partners Identify patterns and systemic issues across the network, escalating structural problems to the Ops Excellence Manager with data-backed recommendations Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Planning, and Procurement to align health diagnostics with broader business objectives Conduct periodic benchmarking analyses across nodes, clusters, and regions to identify performance gaps and best-practice sharing opportunities Present network performance insights and improvement recommendations in governance forums (DDD/WBR/MBR), framing findings with business impact and clear calls-to-action A day in the life Your day starts early — reviewing the automated daily health pulse across all EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL nodes. You spot a DEA drop at three stations in the Southeast cluster and immediately pull the granular data: it's a scan compliance issue tied to a recent route restructuring. By mid-morning, you've completed the root cause analysis and logged it in the corrective action tracker with a clear owner and 72-hour follow-up. You send a concise escalation summary to the regional Ops lead with recommended actions. Before lunch, you finalize the weekly Network Performance Report. This week's highlights: OTD improved 2pp network-wide after last month's UTR process change, but Concessions spiked in the North region. You prepare the talking points for the WBR — crisp, data-backed, with clear "ask" for leadership. After lunch, you deep-dive into a recurring pattern you've been tracking: three nodes with consistently high Ageing 3+ despite corrective actions. You build a hypothesis — shift handoff gaps during multi-cycle operations — and flag it to the Process Improvement leads for structural investigation. Late afternoon, you update your performance governance dashboard, adding a new automated alert for FPY drops below threshold. You also prep a partner support brief for an AMPL partner whose Scorecard has been trending red for two consecutive weeks. You close the day in a 1:1 with your manager (Ops Excellence Manager), reviewing your weekly priorities, sharing the systemic patterns you've identified, and aligning on next week's deep-dive focus areas. About the team The Network Performance function is part of the Ops Excellence team within Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. We support the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission within Ops Excellence is to ensure Last Mile delivery metrics consistently move in the right direction by monitoring network performance, diagnosing defects, and driving data-powered corrective actions. The AMZL Performance Manager is the "eyes of the network" — providing the performance intelligence that fuels process improvement, operational standardization, and partner support across the entire PSX ecosystem.

Vous dirigerez des enquêtes complexes et la gestion d’incidents majeurs, offrirez des conseils techniques aux analystes et représenterez les opérations de sécurité dans le cadre de collaborations avec d’autres équipes de l’organisation. En étroite collaboration avec le/la gestionnaire des opérations de sécurité et le/la responsable technique pour la région EMOA, vous contribuerez à harmoniser les priorités, les normes techniques et les méthodes de travail au sein de notre équipe répartie à l’échelle mondiale. L’un des principaux objectifs de ce poste consiste à accroître la maturité de nos capacités en matière d’opérations de sécurité et d’intervention en cas d’incident, notamment en ce qui concerne la détection, la surveillance, les enquêtes et les interventions. Vous aiderez également l’équipe à renforcer ses compétences techniques et à adopter à grande échelle l’automatisation ainsi que des processus assistés par l’IA. Ce que vous allez faire Diriger et soutenir des enquêtes complexes et la gestion d’incidents majeurs, du triage initial et de l’évaluation des répercussions jusqu’au confinement, à la correction, au rétablissement et à l’analyse après incident. Agir comme point de recours technique pendant les heures de travail des Amériques, notamment en guidant les analystes et les développeur(se)s, en examinant les méthodes d’enquête, en aidant à surmonter les difficultés techniques et en veillant à ce que l’équipe demeure alignée sur les objectifs et les priorités communs. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des processus d’enrichissement des alertes, de triage, d’enquête, de confinement, de gestion des dossiers et de production de rapports. Cerner des possibilités concrètes d’utiliser l’automatisation et l’IA afin de réduire le travail manuel et d’améliorer la qualité des analyses. Créer et ajuster des mécanismes de détection, réduire les alertes inutiles, cerner les lacunes en matière de télémétrie et tirer parti des leçons apprises lors d’incidents pour renforcer les guides d’intervention et de surveillance. Collaborer avec les parties prenantes techniques et non techniques, communiquer clairement les risques et les décisions relatives aux interventions, et contribuer à mener à bien les initiatives de sécurité interfonctionnelles. Ce que nous recherchons Une expérience dans les opérations de sécurité, l’intervention en cas d’incident, le développement de mécanismes de détection, la recherche proactive de menaces ou un rôle connexe en sécurité. Une expérience de direction ou de soutien technique principal lors d’incidents complexes ayant des répercussions importantes. De solides compétences en enquête, notamment la capacité de reconstituer la chronologie d’une attaque et de mettre en corrélation des données provenant d’environnements infonuagiques, de gestion des identités, de terminaux et d’entreprise. Une expérience pratique démontrée des outils modernes d’opérations de sécurité et d’intervention en cas d’incident, y compris des plateformes de surveillance de la sécurité, d’enquête, d’intervention, d’orchestration et d’automatisation. Une expérience dans la création d’automatisations ou d’intégrations à l’aide de scripts, d’API ou de plateformes de gestion des processus. Une connaissance approfondie d’au moins une grande plateforme infonuagique : AWS, GCP ou Azure. Une expérience en mentorat auprès d’analystes et comme point de recours technique. Un excellent jugement et de solides aptitudes en communication, ainsi que la capacité de travailler efficacement sous pression et de représenter les opérations de sécurité auprès de parties prenantes de haut niveau. Une expérience de l’utilisation d’outils assistés par l’IA dans le cadre d’enquêtes, de la détection ou de processus de sécurité constitue un atout important. You will lead complex investigations and major incidents, provide technical guidance to analysts, and represent SecOps when working with other teams across the org. Working closely with the SecOps Manager and EMEA Technical Lead, you will help maintain consistent priorities, technical standards, and ways of working across our globally distributed team. A key focus of this role will be raising the maturity of our SecOps and Incident Response capabilities across detection, monitoring, investigation, and response, while helping the team build stronger technical skills and adopt automation and AI-assisted workflows at scale. What You’ll Be Doing Lead and support complex investigations and major incidents, from initial triage and impact assessment through containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident analysis. Serve as the technical escalation point during Americas hours. Guide analysts and engineers, review investigation approaches, unblock technical challenges, and help the team stay aligned with shared goals and priorities. Design and implement workflows for alert enrichment, triage, investigation, containment, case management, and reporting. Identify practical opportunities to use automation and AI to reduce manual work and improve analytical quality. Build and tune detections, reduce noise, identify telemetry gaps, and use lessons from incidents to strengthen monitoring and response playbooks. Partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clearly communicate risks and response decisions, and help drive cross-functional security work to completion. What We’re Looking For Experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, or a related security role. Experience leading or providing senior technical support during complex and high-impact incidents. Strong investigative skills, including reconstructing attack timelines and correlating data across cloud, identity, endpoint, and corporate environments. Demonstrated hands-on experience with modern SecOps and Incident Response tooling, including platforms for security monitoring, investigation, response, orchestration, and automation. Experience building automations or integrations using scripting, APIs, or workflow platforms. Strong knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience mentoring analysts and acting as a technical escalation point. Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to operate effectively under pressure and represent SecOps with senior stakeholders. Experience applying AI-assisted tools to investigations, detection, or security workflows is highly valued. 회사 소개

쿠팡의 핀테크 사업은 소비자와 판매자 모두가 확장된 금융 서비스 솔루션을 누릴 수 있도록 새로운 방식을 선보이고 있습니다.

쿠팡페이는 Coupang.com 및 쿠팡이츠에서 상품을 구매하는 고객부터 쿠팡의 오픈마켓을 이용하는 판매자 그리고 쿠팡이츠 가맹점까지 쿠팡을 이용하는 모든 이들에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 서비스 솔루션을 제공하는 데 중점을 두고 있습니다. 쿠팡페이는 최신 기술을 통해 한국과 대만의 쿠팡 고객의 니즈에 부응하기 위해 원터치 결제 서비스와 같은 금융 솔루션을 개발합니다.

대출 분야에서는 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 와우 신용 카드 (제휴)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 쿠팡 입점 사업자(셀러)의 사업 성장을 위해 쿠팡페이는 한국 최초의 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 기능을 사용하여 다양한 유동성 옵션을 구축하고 있습니다.

금융과 기술을 결합한 핀테크 분야 내에서 광범위한 경험을 쌓으며 업무하시길 원한다면, 쿠팡 페이와 함께 하세요. 우리는 고객이 계산하는 시간을 줄여서 고객이 좋아하는 것을 쇼핑하는 데 더 많은 시간을 보낼 수 있도록 돕습니다.

직무 소개

Staff Product Designer는 전략 수립부터 실행까지 주요 제품 경험 전반을 주도하는 핵심 리더입니다.
숙련된 경험을 바탕으로 다양한 이해관계자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 본인의 디자인 비전과 아이디어를 구체화하고 최고 수준의 프로덕트를 설계할 수 있는 역량을 요구합니다.

실무형 디자인 리더 (Hands-on Design Leader): 쿠팡 제품 디자인팀은 실무형(Hands-on) 디자인 문화를 지향합니다. 우리는 리더가 디자인 문제를 해결할 때 사려 깊은 프로세스, 세련된 디자인, 고객 중심 관점을 보여주는 숙련된 디자이너가 되기를 기대합니다. 또한 팀 결과의 속도와 품질에 대한 책임을 지게 되므로, 팀을 이끌고 모든 세부 사항에서 우수성을 요구하는 데 자신감을 가져야 합니다.

전체적인 문제 해결사 (Holistic Problem Solver): 리더는 체계적으로 사고하고 직관과 근거(데이터, 모범 사례 벤치마크, 테스트 및 분석 등)를 활용하여 복잡한 고객 문제에 대한 혁신적인 해결책을 찾아야 합니다.

업무 내용

• 고객 경험을 위한 프로덕트 목표 달성 및 디자인 방향성 주도
• 비즈니스 리더, 프로덕트 매니저, 개발, 운영 및 마케팅 등 다양한 이해관계자와의 긴밀한 협업을 통한 전략적 방향성 설정

• 데이터에 기반한 문제 정의 및 UX 전략 수립

• 신규 디바이스 및 미래 사용 환경에 대한 탐색 및 선행 디자인

자격 요건

• 적극적인 실행력과 높은 책임감으로 필요한 업무를 완벽하게 마무리하는 능력 있으신 분

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic trains and serves Claude across multiple cloud providers and accelerator platforms. The Platform Portability team owns the abstractions, tooling, and deployment infrastructure that make this possible without every engineering and research team needing to become experts in different clouds.

As an engineer on Platform Portability, you'll design and build the systems that let us bring up new capacity, ship our platform to cloud provider platforms & marketplaces, and move workloads between providers with confidence. You'll work closely with our cloud partners on capabilities we need that don't exist yet, and with internal Compute, Inference, and Security teams to make "which cloud is this running on?" a question most engineers at Anthropic never have to ask. Your work directly determines how quickly and reliably we can put safe, frontier AI in front of users — wherever they are.

What you'll do

Our work splits into two workstreams, and we need your help across both.

Portable infrastructure. We build the provider-agnostic abstractions for storage, messaging, and connectivity that let Anthropic's systems run on any cloud, and they have to hold up at the scale of frontier model inference. You'll design and build those abstractions, plus the tooling that lets internal teams provision, configure, and operate services across clouds through one consistent interface. You'll also hunt down the provider-specific assumptions hiding in our codebase and set the patterns that keep new ones from creeping in.

Claude on partner clouds. We ship Claude onto third-party cloud platforms, and every launch has to be repeatable. You'll own that delivery end to end, including the build, release, and validation pipelines behind it. You'll work directly with engineering teams at our cloud partners and internal infrastructure stakeholders to land the features we need, debug platform issues, and influence their roadmaps. Expect to go deep on native integrations with each provider, and to do the cross-cutting work that keeps our platform consistent across all of them.

Across both, you'll shape how the rest of Anthropic builds for multiple clouds. You'll review designs with cloud-portability implications, mentor engineers across the org on multi-cloud patterns, and bring internal stakeholders into alignment through clear writing and conversation. You'll also take your turn in the on-call rotation, and you'll design the postmortems, runbooks, and incident response that help us never fail the same way twice.

You might be a good fit if you:

• Have a minimum of 8 years of practical experience building and operating production distributed systems
• Own large-scale infrastructure systems and lead ambiguous, cross-team technical projects from design through production
• Run the same production workload across multiple cloud providers, including the migration or abstraction work that made it possible
• Understand how cloud IAM models and networking primitives (VPC peering, private connectivity, service mesh) differ across providers
• Write production code in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go, or Rust)
• Work confidently with Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi)
• Understand ML infrastructure and supporting interconnects
• Ship software through hyperscaler marketplaces or managed-model platforms
• Bring a background in security, compliance, or data residency for regulated or sovereign cloud environments
• Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

1st Shift- No Weekends
$17-22 Based on Experience

Responsible for evaluating and reviewing the company's overall inventory management.
Essential Job Duties

• The ideal candidate will have intensive background working with salvage automobile parts and interchanges
• Ability to work independently while staying on task to meet increasing performance demands
• Must be able to accurately identify vehicle make, model and options.
• Must decipher manufacture option codes on vehicles and parts to accurately identify interchange of parts
• Evaluate inventory levels for all salvage automobile inventory and determine proper product stocking.
• Communicate opportunities found within inventory.
• Research and investigate missing inventory.
• Correct errors found by corporate oversight.
• Evaluate inventory for accuracy.
• Assume other duties as assigned.
• Collaborate with management and the dismantle team to make process adjustments as directed.
• Ability to endure outdoor environments through the majority of the shift (extreme hot or cold, rain, snow)
• Must be fluent in or learning and using technology (smart phone, tablet, computer)

Supervisory Responsibilities

• Not responsible for supervising employees.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

• High School Diploma/GED
• 1+ years of related experience required
• Requires past experience working in the inventory department within the company.

Preferred Requirements

• Experience within inventory controls.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
• Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc.
• Regularly uses moderately complex oral and written skills. May train others in functional areas, interact with others and make presentations to department or middle management.
• Problems encountered are routine, somewhat repetitive and generally solved by following clear directions and procedures.
• Decisions generally affect own job or assigned functional area.
• Results are defined; sets personal own goals and determines how to achieve results with few or no guidelines to follow; supervisor/manager provides broad guidance and overall direction.
• Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.
• No additional competencies required.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, reach, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or sit for extended periods of time.
• The employee may be exposed to hazardous situations, conditions, and equipment. Must be able to work in cramped spaces or underneath vehicles that may require getting into awkward positions. May regularly wear personal protective equipment (PPE). May be exposed to extreme temperatures and high noise levels.
• Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays (contingent on position requirements).
• The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. On occasion an employee may be asked to lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.

Benefits:

• Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
• Paid Time Off
• Paid Parental Leave
• Fertility Coverage
• 401k with Generous Company Match
• Company Paid Life Insurance and Long-Term Disability
• Short-Term Disability
• Employee Assistance Program
• Tuition Reimbursement
• Employee Discounts
• PNC Daily Pay Option

Join us for an exciting career journey with positive, driven individuals.

jobs.description: The Retail Service Specialist will support the Store Manager and Assistant Managers in areas of sales, customer service, store appearance, and store operations. This position will also assume shift management responsibilities in the absence of Assistant or Store Manager. Bilingual candidates encouraged to apply. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Lead store team members in providing excellent customer service to retail and professional customers. Supervise the customer service levels on the retail showroom to include team member execution on customer service programs (Related sales, Hi5, Rock the Call, Never Say No, Rock the Lot, etc…) Ensure telephone is answered according to company policy. Ensure all buy online/ship to store, hub and store to store transfers, and DC add orders are processed in a timely manner and customers are contacted upon shipment arrivals as needed. Ensure special orders and outside purchases are handled efficiently and according to procedure, utilizing electronic outside purchase order ledger. Ensure retail customer returns and exchanges are processed in an efficient and friendly manner, refunds are issued accurately using the correct payment methods, and returned merchandise is processed or staged in the returns area correctly. Ensure all merchandise, including core charges and warranties, are invoiced before product leaves the store. Ensure that Zipline messages are communicated and Image Maker and merchandising tasks are delegated and completed as assigned. Ensure team members are adhering to the posted work schedule, changes/deviations are being approved by a member of management, and team members are clocking in/out according to company policy. Perform all store opening/closing duties, including performing day end procedures, verifying/securing money/deposits according to company policy, preparing bank deposits as needed, ensuring all night security lights are on, locking doors and securing building, arming/disarming security alarms, and checking/securing/locking delivery vehicle(s) parked in secure designated area. All other duties as assigned. jobs.description: Job Description We are seeking an experienced Network Data Analyst to join our Data Insights and Visualization team . The role will evaluate log and alert data from network components globally, providing insights for proactive decision making. The Network Data Analyst will join the Data Insights and Visualization team to design, develop, and operate visual analytics and embedded tools that surface actionable, timely insights from network telemetry. You will be instrumental in integrating agentic AI agents and AIOps capabilities into dashboards and automation workflows so NCOS stakeholders can detect, triage, and resolve issues before they impact the business. Key responsibilities: Design and deliver end-to-end telemetry analytics and interactive dashboards that combine network flow, metrics, logs, traces, and business context to reduce time-to-insight and time-to-resolution. Identify, mine and normalize network data sources (Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces) and integrate them into real-time pipelines and visualization layers. Develop agentic AI agents and AIOps components that continuously analyze streaming telemetry to detect anomalies, infer root causes, prioritize incidents, and surface proactive recommendations to stakeholders. Embed AI-driven insights into visualizations and web applications so executives, product leaders, SREs and network engineers receive role-appropriate, actionable views. Build reusable visualization components, templates, and libraries for NCOS product lines to ensure consistency across routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, SD‑WAN, and core application observability. Contribute to telemetry data quality improvement, and performance measurement initiatives for critical network components. Professional competencies Strong communicator who can translate technical analysis into clear, concise presentations for peers, managers, and executives. Passion for building simple, well-designed, and highly usable analytics applications that deliver measurable value to stakeholders. Collaborative team player able to coordinate cross-functional work and deliver on time. Required experience Exposure to large global network infrastructures (routers, switches, LAN, SD‑WAN, firewalls, wireless). HS Diploma required Exposure to network monitoring, and observability tools such as LogicMonitor, Thousand Eyes, Big Panda, Dynatrace, NetBrain, Grafana Cloud, Zscaler ZDX, or similar. Practical experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks, or building conversational interfaces (chatbots) that translate user intent into structured queries (SQL, API calls, or platform-specific query languages). 2+ years building visualizations and dashboards in BI/observability platforms such as Spotfire, Power BI, Grafana (Cloud/OSS), or equivalent. Proven experience building actionable dashboards and role-based views for executives, product owners, and engineers. Experience embedding visualizations in web applications and building reusable visualization components. Proficiency with one or more general-purpose programming languages and web frameworks: JavaScript (React/Vue), Python (Django/Flask), Java, or similar. Preferred Experience: Associate-level developer certifications (AWS, Python, SQL) or equivalent hands-on experience. Experience with knowledge graphs, causal analysis, or explainable AI applied to root-cause and dependency analysis. Familiarity integrating agents with ITSM/incident platforms (ServiceNow or similar) and network automation tools (Ansible, or similar).
